name: worker-multiple-receive-test-98321dc2b9/worker-multiple-receive-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list does not include named worker declarations or worker send actions.
## Expressions: "[Start action]" and "[Wait action]" are listed, but worker receive and multiple receive actions are not listed.
# Subset restrictions / ## Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; "ballerina/lang.error" lists only "message".
## Invocations / ### Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes "error:message", but not error:detail.
reason: The essential behavior is communication between named workers using sends and multiple receives, including error/panic propagation and missing-message results. Named workers, sends and receives are not covered by the positive lists; support for start/wait alone does not cover them. Conditional-send cases additionally require lang.error:NoMessage and error.detail(), outside the explicit langlib allowlist.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and worker sends (->)
Worker receives, especially multiple receive (<- { ... }) into maps/records
Worker error/panic propagation and conditional-send NoMessage behavior
test_design_notes: The main function combines twelve worker scenarios; the entire case is feature scope even though ordinary maps, records, wait, trap, type tests, runtime:sleep and error.message have listed support.
@output markers assert missing-message error text/detail and panic selection, beyond mere function signatures. No @args or @panic markers are present. io:println is instrumentation.
